selector.rationale: Vaginal biopsy showed grade 3 endometrioid adenocarcinoma, and PET-CT showed multiple hypermetabolic masses in the pelvis, abdomen, and chest, which supports the diagnosis of Endometrioid adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Iatrogenic tumor dissemination
rejected.why: Lack of evidence of tumor dissemination during surgery

rejected.label: Leiomyomatosis peritonealis disseminata
rejected.why: Pathology re-review of the hysterectomy and oophorectomy specimens showed no evidence of malignancy, and the clinical presentation is more consistent with Endometrioid adenocarcinoma

rejected.label: Endometriosis
rejected.why: While superficial pelvic endometriosis was noted during surgery, the current clinical presentation and biopsy results are more consistent with Endometrioid adenocarcinoma
